title: Etale-space realization of an arbitrary etale sheaf and pro-etale comparison
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and use the small etale and pro-etale sites and comparison $
u_X$ of [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. Enlarge the ambient universe if necessary so that the disjoint union of a set of representable generators with sections of a given sheaf is an allowed scheme [def-weil-size-convention]. For an algebraic space $E$ over $X$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], say $E	o X$ is etale when the composite $V	o X$ is etale for every representable etale scheme chart $V	o E$ [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Write $h_E^{\mathrm{et}}(V)=\operatorname{Hom}_X(V,E)$ and $h_E^{\mathrm{proet}}(U)=\operatorname{Hom}_X(U,E)$ on these two sites. The functor $E\mapsto h_E^{\mathrm{et}}$ from etale algebraic spaces over $X$ whose displayed section sets lie in the chosen sheaf universe to sheaves of sets in that universe on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ is an equivalence. There is a canonical natural isomorphism $
u_X^*h_E^{\mathrm{et}}\cong h_E^{\mathrm{proet}}$. For every weakly etale $u:U	o X$, the base change $E_U=E	imes_XU$ is etale over $U$ and these identifications restrict to $h_E^{\mathrm{proet}}|_U\cong
u_U^*h_{E_U}^{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-weakly-etale-morphism, def-pc-fibre-product].
